Soil quality suffers when loud noise causes compaction, reducing air and water flow and decreasing fertility. Aquatic environments are also affected, as noise disrupts the natural behaviours of aquatic organisms, affecting their ability to feed and reproduce. Overall, noise pollution harms biodiversity and disturbs ecosystem balance.
